observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 178.» (L9) and «p. 179.» (L30, beside the head of chapter 49) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 49: 30 stands in the space under L29, beside no line; 35 beside the second line of the title; 40 beside L36.
body L30-L32: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type and centred; the title is in two lines.
body L17: the semicolon after «cognoscas» is printed low, its comma under the line.
body L17, L20, L28, L40: specks stand over the u of «tantum», over the m of «trium», over the u of «supra» and after «figurae»; they are not signs.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
